basis: RFC 7692 6.2 (decompression algorithm; silent on failure) + RFC 6455 7.1.7 (SHOULD send a Close frame with an appropriate status code, MAY omit it); candidate codes 1002 (protocol error) and 1007 (invalid frame payload data).
reason: A failed decompression (a corrupted or truncated DEFLATE stream) is not a failure mode RFC 7692 assigns a Close frame to; the RFC's only obligation is to fail the connection (MUST). The implementation reports the error directly to the reader and sends no Close frame, taking the 7.1.7 MAY. Accepted: the SHOULD target set {1002, 1007} is under-specified by the RFC, and a bare teardown is the MAY outcome the RFC explicitly permits.

basis: RFC 6455 7.4.2 (1009 'message too big') + RFC 7692 8 (decompression bombs, informative) + project maxMessageSize policy (the limit is not an RFC concept); candidate codes 1002 (protocol error) and 1009 (message too big).
reason: A decompressed payload that exceeds the project's maxMessageSize while decompressing has no RFC-mandated Close frame: the limit is project policy and RFC 7692 is silent on the overflow. The implementation reports the error directly to the reader and sends no Close frame, taking the 7.1.7 MAY. Accepted: the SHOULD target set {1002, 1009} is under-specified, and a bare teardown is the MAY outcome the RFC permits.
